chunks: Appreciate my advice, O my child,

and know that He Who is the Master of death is also the Master of life, that the Creator causes death as well; that He Who destroys is also the restorer of life and that He Who inflicts disease is also the curer.
This world continues in the way Allāh has made it with regard to its pleasures, trials, rewards on the Day of Judgement and all that He wishes and you do not know.
If anything of this advice is not understood by you then attribute it to your ignorance of it, because when you were first born you were born ignorant. Thereafter, you acquired knowledge.
There are many matters of which you are ignorant and in which your sight first wonders and your eye wanders then after this you see them.
Therefore, cling to Him Who created you, fed you and put you in order. Your worship should be for Him, your eagerness should be towards Him and your fear should be of Him.
ai.seo_question: What are the key divine attributes regarding life and death in Imam Ali's advice to Hasan?
ai.summary: Delivered during the pivotal post-Siffin period, this instruction underscores the theological principle of *Tawhid* by linking God’s creative and destructive powers to His singular sovereignty, urging Hasan to accept worldly trials as divine wisdom. The Imam emphasizes epistemological humility, reminding Hasan that initial ignorance is natural and that true insight comes from clinging to God, thereby framing spiritual resilience amidst political turmoil as an act of worship.
